examPattern.mode: Prelims Objective (GS Paper I + CSAT Paper II) -> Mains Written (9 Papers) -> Personality Test
examPattern.totalMarks: Prelims: 200 Marks per paper (CSAT qualifying at 33%); Mains: 1750 Marks + 275 Interview

domains.name: General Studies Paper I (NCERT Class 6-12 Spine)
topics: Indian Polity and Governance (Constitution, Rights, Federalism, Panchayati Raj)
History of India and Indian National Movement + Art & Culture
Indian and World Geography + Environment, Biodiversity & Climate Change
Economic and Social Development, Sustainable Development & General Science

domains.name: CSAT Paper II (Class X Level Numeracy & Comprehension)
topics: Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Data Interpretation
Basic Numeracy (Numbers, Orders of Magnitude - Class X Level)
